reasons: Cited clause 2.1 expressly states no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further orders is not a breach or shortfall, which squarely meets the MINCOMMIT preferred position.
Supporting clauses 7.1 (no unidentified minimum-use charges) and 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment) reinforce compliance; no volume caps on Customer usage are present.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the original paragraphs are unchanged in the rendered output.
Rationale is accurate and the audit-related true-up is correctly distinguished from a take-or-pay shortfall penalty.
